info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Rideshare Rides API allows users to effectively remove or cancel rideshare bookings in the system. This endpoint is essential for ensuring that passengers can manage their ride reservations with ease, especially in situations where plans change. Typical consumers of this API include rideshare service apps and user management systems that need to provide cancellation features to their users. By utilizing this API, clients can enhance user experience and operational efficiency associated with managing rideshare engagements.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel a previously scheduled ride. It's essential to ensure that cancellations are handled in a timely manner to avoid unnecessary charges.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a ride. A valid ride ID must be provided to process the cancellation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a ride operation. It is expected to be a string.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Ride Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The state of the ride after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time of the cancellation operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a ride operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the cancellation record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details regarding the audit of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Specifies the processing time for the request, allowing clients to understand the latency involved.

schema.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
